description: This file defines the Java class 'Form' within the OpenMRS project. It models a form entity with properties like formId, version, build, published status, encounterType, and a set of formFields. It includes constructors, property accessors, and methods to manage associated form fields, as well as overridden toString, getId, and setId methods.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Represents a form object in OpenMRS, including metadata and associated fields, with functionality to manage its form fields.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the form.

methods.name: setFormId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the form.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the form.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version string of the form.

methods.name: getBuild
methods.description: Returns the build number of the form.

methods.name: setBuild
methods.description: Sets the build number of the form.

methods.name: getPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the form is published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the form.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Returns the encounter type associated with the form.

methods.name: setEncounterType
methods.description: Sets the encounter type for the form.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Returns the set of form fields associated with the form.

methods.name: getOrderedFormFields
methods.description: Returns a list of form fields ordered by their field number.

methods.name: setFormFields
methods.description: Sets the set of form fields.

methods.name: addFormField
methods.description: Adds a form field to the set of form fields.

methods.name: removeFormField
methods.description: Removes a specified form field from the set.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the form, mainly its ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the form's ID, overriding the superclass method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the form's ID, overriding the superclass method.
